title: people-ops-recruiting-coordinator-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-11
content:
Daily scratchpad - Avery Liu (recruiting coordinator)
Date: 2026-03-11
---
Morning triage:
- Check calendar conflicts before 9:30am (most urgent: Eng hiring panel 10:00am PT)
- Review any candidate cancellations/reschedules from overnight (esp EMEA candidates)
- Pull latest feedback for IC-Frontend role (hiring manager left notes)

Top priorities for today:
1) Candidate follow-ups (send next-step emails / decline politely)
   - Send follow-up to Priya K. (SWE Intern) - ask for coding sample availability this week (30-60 min pair). Target: send by 9:15am.
   - Decline note to Mateo R. (DS) - feedback consolidated; personalize with 2 bullets. Target: 11am.
   - Confirm offer call time with Nora S. (PM) - manager prefers 3/12 11am PT. Need Nora's timezones.

2) Scheduling / interview ops
   - 10:00am PT - Eng hiring panel (Zoom): confirm panelists: Sarah, Omar, Lee. Tasks: upload candidate brief to calendar, add Slack reminder.
   - 2:00pm PT - Loop in interview room for on-site logistics (in-office candidate). Confirm desk/ID badge.
   - Block 4:30-5:00pm for buffer/reschedules

3) Scorecards & feedback flow
   - Remind interviewers to submit scorecards within 24h. Template quick links in Slack channel #hiring-swe.
   - Resolve missing scorecard for IC-Backend (interviewer: Dan M.) - ping Dan after panel.

4) Offer pipeline
   - Draft comp summary for Nora S. (PM) based on band 4 ranges. Use manager notes from Confluence page.
   - Pre-approval checklist: legal template, total comp sign-off, manager approval. Follow up with Liz in People Ops if not signed by EOD Thursday.

Notes / quick snippets to copy/paste:
- Interview scheduling message to candidate:
  "Thanks for your flexibility - we have availability on [DATE/TIME OPTIONS] for a 60-minute interview. Please reply with your preferred slot and timezone.
  Zoom link will be sent once confirmed. If you need accommodations, let us know."

- Easy decline template (short):
  "Hi [NAME], thanks again for your time interviewing with Redwood. After careful consideration we won't be moving forward at this time. We appreciate your interest and will keep your resume on file for future roles. Wishing you all the best. - Avery"

Open questions / follow-ups for team:
- Can hiring manager for Frontend confirm expected take-home test timeline? (mgr: Lee)
- Need updated interview rubric for PM role (product sense section) - who owns this? Add to backlog if not done.

Timeboxed to-dos (today):
- 09:00-09:30: send follow-ups + calendar hygiene
- 09:30-10:00: prep candidate brief for 10am panel
- 10:00-11:30: manage live panel and note missing scorecards
- 11:30-12:00: decline/offer emails drafts
- 13:30-14:00: coordinate on-site logistics
- 14:00-16:00: open scheduling/reschedule window + buffer for interviews
- 16:30-17:00: wrap up, update ATS notes, move candidates in pipeline

Random notes (brain dump):
- Candidate Priya asked about relocation stipend - check band policy, add to offer checklist if applicable.
- Consider making a canned Slack post for "missing scorecard" reminders to reduce manual pings.
- Suggest weekly 15-min huddle with hiring managers to align on timelines - trial next Wed.

Things to add to Confluence after today:
- Updated scheduling SOP (zoom links, buffer windows, timezone guidance)
- Example decline + counter-offer language
- On-site checklist (desk, badge, directions)

End-of-day checklist:
- All interviewers submitted scorecards? (yes/no)
- Candidate follow-ups sent? (yes/no)
- Offers drafted & approvals requested? (yes/no)
- ATS updated for moved/declined candidates? (yes/no)

Notes to self: keep response templates short, prioritize candidate experience, escalate blocker to People Ops manager (Liz) if legal takes >48h on offer templates.

----
Contextual links (quick):
- Confluence hiring templates: confluence://people-ops/hiring-templates
- ATS candidate list (search: "Mar-2026 SWE candidates")
- Slack channel: #hiring-swe

End of scratchpad.
